title: 2027 Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: After significant updates for 2026, the Kia Sportage Plug-in Hybrid goes into the 2027 model year unchanged. It remains a high-tech, value focused rival for cars such as the Hyundai Tucson Plug-In Hybrid and the Toyota RAV4 Plug-In Hybrid.
body_markdown:
Like its gas-only and hybrid siblings, the Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid brings value to the compact crossover SUV segment. Key competitors with plug-in hybrid (PHEV) powertrains include the Toyota RAV4 Plug-In Hybrid, the Hyundai Tucson Plug-In Hybrid, and the Mitsubishi Outlander Sport Plug-In Hybrid.

## What’s New for the 2027 Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid


The Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid goes into the 2027 model year unchanged. Though there are some updates to the related Sportage Hybrid, which we review separately, the Sportage Plug-In Hybrid has a much smaller trim lineup. It’s available in X-Line and X-Line Prestige trims, both of which include all-wheel drive (AWD). The Sportage Plug-In Hybrid was introduced for the 2023 model year and was refreshed for 2026 with updated styling, new infotainment features, and more horsepower.


## Design


The Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid looks and feels new, but it’s in its fifth year and received a redesign for 2026. This compact SUV fits in well among Kia’s current lineup, and there’s little to visually call out this version of the Sportage as a PHEV. Both trim levels come standard with 19-inch wheels.


## Powertrain


The Sportage Plug-In Hybrid features a 1.6-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine, an electric motor, and a 13.8-kWh battery pack, and is good for 268 horsepower. All-wheel drive is standard, and a six-speed automatic transmission offers smooth and linear acceleration. The Sportage PHEV is rated for up to 34 miles of all-electric range and can reach a full charge in two hours with a Level 2 charger.


## Interior


Like the rest of the Sportage lineup, the Sportage Plug-In Hybrid seats five across two rows, though the second row is a tight squeeze for three adults. The cabin is well equipped, since the Sportage Plug-In Hybrid is available only in two premium trim levels. Standard features include synthetic leather upholstery, a power-adjustable driver’s seat, and heated front seats. Options include a power-adjustable front passenger seat, heated rear outboard seats, and ventilated front seats. This version of the Sportage offers 34.5 cubic feet of storage space behind the second row, which opens to 65.5 cubic feet with the second row folded—generous for a PHEV. A hands-free power liftgate comes standard.


## Technology


The Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid features a 12.3-inch digital instrument display and a 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment display. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are standard, along with wireless device charging and a six-speaker audio system. The stereo is upgraded to an eight-speaker Harman Kardon system with the X-Line Prestige trim.

## Safety


The Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid is available only in premium trim levels, so it's packed with safety features, including a rear-view camera, forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, pedestrian and cyclist detection, front and rear parking sensors, stop-and-go adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, a lane-departure warning system, lane-keep assist, a rear-seat alert system, and an exit-warning system. Options include semi-automated highway driving assist, a surround-view camera system, a blind-spot camera (which displays a live camera feed of the blind spot when the turn signal is active), and a remote smart parking system. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration and the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety had not crash-tested the 2027 Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid at the time of writing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Kia Sportage Plug-In Hybrid is on sale now. At the time of writing, the X-Line started at $40,590 and the X-Line Prestige at $47,390. These prices do not include the Sportage Plug-In Hybrid’s $1,495 destination fee.
